title: State v. Shaw (N.J. 2012)
key_points: Holding: Officers executing a warrant for one person may not detain someone else simply because he is nearby or shares a general characteristic with the wanted person.
officer_notes: Scenario: Looking for a wanted man described only by race, you stop a different man walking out of the same building.
Takeaway: Detain only people who actually match a specific description or about whom you have independent suspicion.
